result: No remaining findings. The two-cell documentation mismatch identified during review is corrected in the separate docs-only commit.
review_scope: Read-only source, plan, coverage, budget and failure-propagation review; no native workload timing.
checks: Moved only PR plan ownership; full-profile code, workflows, scaling implementation and report gate are unchanged.
The native AOT step precedes scaling-1 in the real shell plan and retains its stage-2 compiler and complete quarter of the corpus.
Real-shell failure injection verifies a passing AOT step followed by failed scaling produces a failed step, failed report and nonzero command status.
Merge tests reject missing or duplicated scaling steps even with plausible passing summaries, and reject overlapping scaling shapes.
PR native coverage traverses named native steps rather than assuming the native step is last, so the additional step preserves exact case-by-mode coverage.
Both modified test suites are registered in Lint via the existing test_*verif*.py controls; workflow limits run separately.
The documentation correction changes only the Native AOT and Benchmarks coverage cells to match the plan.
limitation: Hosted CI on the final RC.2 tree remains required; source and mocked harness tests do not guarantee real job duration or release qualification.
